## Functions, classes and values

### `atLeastOnce`

`function atLeastOnce(name: string, effect: EffectSelector, key: string, expected: readonly JsonValue[]): AtLeastOnce`

Every value in `expected` appears at least once as `key` in a selected effect: nothing was lost. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/core/src/delivery-invariants.ts)

### `atLeastOncePerMessage`

`function atLeastOncePerMessage(name: string, drive: Drive, effect: EffectSelector, key: string, bodyKey: string): AtLeastOnce`

Every message's (or request's, or call's) `bodyKey` value must appear at least once as `key` in a selected effect: nothing the drive delivered may be lost. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `atMostOncePerKey`

`function atMostOncePerKey(name: string, effect: EffectSelector, key: string): AtMostOncePerKey`

No two selected effects share the value at `key` (a dot path into the effect's payload): nothing happened twice for one key, a payment recorded twice, a message sent twice. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/core/src/delivery-invariants.ts)

### `createCloudflarePlatform`

`function createCloudflarePlatform(options: CloudflarePlatformOptions): Platform`

The Cloudflare platform for `check`, run inside workerd under the Cloudflare Vitest plugin: the scenario's drive delivered to the Worker's handlers, its bindings proxied so every call is an effect that faults can hit, and the setup's resources reset before each run and snapshotted after it. ## Types

### `CalleeModule`

`interface CalleeModule`

The callee's module as the test gives it: the Worker's name from its wrangler config, which qualifies its bindings, its exports, and what the caller's service binding carries in its own config: the `entrypoint` the binding reaches (the scenario's `callee()` may name one too, and wins) and the `props` the callee reads from `ctx.props`. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/callees.ts)

### `CalleeSetup`

`interface CalleeSetup`

The Worker behind a service binding, run for real: its module and wrangler config, relative to the scenario, in place of a script. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `CheckTransport`

`interface CheckTransport`

What the generated test stores in its task meta. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cli/src/workerd.ts)

### `CloudflarePlatformOptions`

`interface CloudflarePlatformOptions`

What `createCloudflarePlatform` needs: the env and the Worker's default export, the schema per D1 binding, and for the bindings that need them the test helpers, the module's exports, the callees and the aliases. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/platform.ts)

### `CloudflareRegressionOptions`

`interface CloudflareRegressionOptions`

What `cloudflareRegressionTest` needs to write the test: import paths of the scenario, the Worker and its schema files, relative to the emitted file, and what the platform was given when the check ran. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cli/src/regression.ts)

### `CloudflareScenarioInput`

`interface CloudflareScenarioInput`

The input to `defineScenario`: the Worker, the drive, the setup steps, the externals it fetches, the invariants, the bounds (merged with the defaults) and the core modules whose specs run. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `CronDrive`

`interface CronDrive`

Drive the Worker's `scheduled()` handler with the ticks of a Cron Trigger: the expression's first `ticks` matches from the virtual epoch on, in UTC, each an event delivered at its virtual time. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `CronOptions`

`interface CronOptions`

How many ticks of the expression to drive, and how many times a tick whose handler failed is re-run. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `CronTickSpec`

`type CronTickSpec`

One tick of a Cron Trigger: its id and the virtual time it fires, which the handler sees as `scheduledTime`. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `D1Setup`

`interface D1Setup`

Apply a SQL file to a D1 binding before each run. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `DifferentialResult`

### `DurableObjectSetup`

Clear a Durable Object namespace before each run and seed the named objects' storage with these entries; its storage is snapshotted after the run for state invariants (see `durableObjectRows`). [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `DurableObjectSqlSeed`

### `HttpCallerOptions`

[Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

The RPC drive's entrypoint (a named export; default the default export) and how its caller resends a call that threw or got no answer: `retries` (default 0), `delaysMs` and `deadlineMs`, as for `http`. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `RpcCallInput`

### `RpcCallSpec`

`type RpcCallSpec`

A type alias, not an interface, so it is assignable to the JSON shape of `PlatformData`. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `RpcDrive`

`interface RpcDrive`

Drive a `WorkerEntrypoint` of the Worker with these method calls, one invocation per attempt, the entrypoint constructed anew for each. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `ScriptedObjectSetup`

`interface ScriptedObjectSetup`

Script the objects of a Durable Object namespace: every object of the namespace answers its RPC methods from `methods` and its `fetch()` from `fetch`, as a scripted service does (see `ServiceSetup`), and no object of the namespace is constructed or run. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `ScriptedReply`

`type ScriptedReply`

A scripted method's reply: a value returned to the caller, or an error (`"<Name>: <message>"`) thrown to it. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `ServiceResponse`

`type ServiceResponse`

A reply to `fetch()` through a service binding; a type alias of core's `ScriptedResponse`, for the JSON shape. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `ServiceSetup`

`interface ServiceSetup`

Script the Worker another Worker reaches through a service binding: its RPC methods answer from `methods` (every method returns `null` when omitted; a method missing from a present `methods` makes the run UNSUPPORTED) and its `fetch()` from `fetch`, matched by method and path as an external's responses are (200 with an empty body when omitted). [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `SpecEntry`

`interface SpecEntry`

A generated spec entry: the module's specs, read on the Node side, and a loader of its spec file. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cli/src/workerd.ts)

### `SqlRow`

`type SqlRow`

One row to insert, or one row snapshotted: column name to value (booleans and objects as SQLite stores them). [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `WebSocketConnectionInput`

`interface WebSocketConnectionInput`

One connection to open: the path of its upgrade request, its headers and the messages to send on it. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `WebSocketDrive`

`interface WebSocketDrive`

Drive the Worker over WebSocket connections: each connection is opened with an upgrade request to its path (one event) and its messages are sent in order (one event each, after its connection opened and its previous message was handled); every connection closes at the end of the run. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `WebSocketMessageInput`

`interface WebSocketMessageInput`

One message to send on a connection: its data (a JSON value is sent as its text) and an optional id. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/scenario.ts)

### `WorkerdCheckInput`

### `WorkerEntrypointClass`

`type WorkerEntrypointClass`

A `WorkerEntrypoint` subclass: the Worker's default export when it exposes RPC methods. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/cloudflare/src/platform.ts)
